intent_snapshot.goal: Implement the Pi Host gate for unattended batch runs at parity with the Claude Code gate, as required by docs/specs/unattended-initiative-batch-run.spec.md section 3.6 and the dual-host delivery decision: the Pi extension presents the same Kernel-derived batch confirmation through its native TUI, issues the same Batch Authorization, and both Hosts are asserted equivalent by one shared conformance test.

acceptance.assertion: The Pi extension exposes an unattended batch entry whose confirmation is rendered through the native TUI confirm surface and whose content is derived from projectBatchPlan and Kernel state, presenting the Initiative, batch branch, ordered child list with risk, excluded children, budget, and expires_at, and bound to the same plan_digest. Accept issues one Batch Authorization through the same Kernel registry and calls the same startBatch driver; the extension mints no capability and owns no batch state transition. Decline, cancel, a non-interactive Pi invocation, an active workspace claim, a failing branch preflight, and an empty enrollable child set each perform zero Kernel writes, zero batch state, and no new Git ref, and report a stable reason with exactly one same-Host recovery action.

One shared conformance assertion in tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts drives the identical batch confirmation scenario through both the Claude Code and Pi adapters and requires the same issued Batch Authorization binding, the same accepted and rejected outcomes with the same stable reason codes, and the same zero-write guarantees, so neither Host can authorize an unattended batch the other would refuse. Existing dual-host resume and assurance conformance coverage continues to pass unchanged.

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/imm-unattended-batch.ts:368：生产 realPort.advanceTask 无条件返回 completed，projectTask 同样返回伪造的无 claim 投影；注册工具未覆盖这些实现。直接调用的未修改文件 plugins/immune-brain/runtime/unattended/batch_runner.ts 表明 driver 信任 completed 并持久化 settled、立即尝试提交，因此真实任务未经实现、QA、Review 或 Kernel terminal settlement 就进入提交路径。接入真实 Kernel projection 和 assurance progression，返回真实 enrollment revision，并增加不覆盖这些生产端口的测试。

plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/imm-unattended-batch.ts:193：confirmBatch 可选且 decision 默认 accept，interactive 也默认 true；调用公开执行入口时遗漏确认端口即可签发授权并创建分支和 batch 状态，完全没有用户确认。确认端口缺失时必须以稳定原因零写入拒绝，并仅允许显式 accept 进入授权路径；补充缺失端口和无效返回值测试。

plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/imm-unattended-batch.ts:188：确认详情先筛选 enrollable，再据同一 status 将每个 child 的风险固定显示为 material，因此 routine child 也被错误显示为 material，风险没有来自 Kernel intent。使用与计划中 intent identity 一致的实际 risk，并在 tests/pi-batch-authority.test.ts:117 的 routine/material fixture 中分别断言准确风险。

tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts:467：新增 conformance 使用不同 child identity 的两套 fixture，只比较 accepted 状态和 child 数量，从未观察或比较签发的 Batch Authorization binding，也未断言稳定 reason code 一致；branch preflight 和 empty child 场景缺失，零写入检查主要只验证 batch 目录不存在。通过共享场景驱动两端，捕获并核对真实授权绑定与签发次数，覆盖全部拒绝场景并比较 Kernel 状态及 Git refs 前后快照，才能保护本次明确要求的授权一致性。

plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/imm-unattended-batch.ts:89 与 :444：Pi 非交互拒绝的唯一 recovery action 要求升级 Claude Code，无法修复当前 Pi Host 的非交互调用，违反 same-Host recovery 要求；改为在交互式 Pi TUI 中重新发起该请求，并修正 tests/pi-batch-authority.test.ts:109 中固化错误 Host 的断言。

tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts:466 新增 conformance 没有断言稳定 reason code 的一致性。实际 Pi decline 返回 code=user_denied、active claim 返回 code=active_claim_exists，而 Claude kernel_ports.ts 的对应返回对象没有 code；测试只比较 reason 文案，因此明确要求的代码一致性未实现。assertZeroWrites 也只检查两个目录是否存在和 HEAD OID，不比较 refs、workspace 或 backend claim；创建指向原 HEAD 的新分支或改写现有 authority 文件仍会通过。应统一两个 adapter 的稳定错误投影，通过共享断言比较 code，并比较调用前后的全部相关 authority 状态及 refs。

plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/runtime-stub.ts:476 creates a separate AssuranceProgression for batch advancement. Its Review reservation is inaccessible to the existing Pi submit_review handler, which uses the different progression instantiated at imm-canary-work.ts:314 and invoked at :544. Furthermore, the shared batch runner discards agent_params when returning its review_ready report, and the entry creates a new batch on every invocation, rejecting the existing active claim or branch instead of resuming it. Consequently a real child reaching Review cannot follow the report's recovery instruction. Unchanged dependencies inspected to trace this affected state machine: runtime/assurance/coordinator.ts:746 rejects submissions without the instance-local reservation; runtime/unattended/batch_runner.ts:808 pauses and requires submission followed by continuation of the same batch. Reuse the session-owned Pi progression, expose the reserved foreground Agent parameters, and retain/recover the same batch identity through the shared resume path. Add a production-port Review handoff and continuation test.

plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/runtime-stub.ts:498 passes the entire TaskRecord to taskDiffIdentity instead of its scope array. Every projection with an existing record therefore fails with 'task scope must contain at least one canonical path', breaking claim reconciliation and resume. Unchanged dependencies inspected because this new adapter calls them: runtime/workspace_scope.ts:242 requires a nonempty array, and runtime/kernel/assurance_projection.ts:281 invokes the supplied callback for an existing record. Reuse the established Pi projection implementation or its diffSnapshotOf logic at imm-canary-work.ts:1157, which selects revision identity when appropriate and otherwise uses record.intent_snapshot.scope_hint. Cover an existing enrolled and terminal record through the real adapter.

tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts:510 defines assertZeroWrites using only absence of batch/tasks directories and unchanged HEAD. This passes if an adapter creates a new branch at the same HEAD or modifies workspace/claim authority files, so it does not enforce the explicitly required zero Kernel writes and no-new-ref guarantees. The scenarios also bypass the registered Pi tool through executePiUnattendedBatch, and several rejection cases assert different host-specific outcomes or substrings rather than equal stable reason codes. Exercise both actual host entry adapters with normalized host envelopes, snapshot all relevant Kernel state and Git refs before/after each rejection, and compare the required reason codes. The manifest's passing QA outcomes are acknowledged; these are gaps in what those passing assertions establish.

[P1] plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/imm-unattended-batch.ts:121 and plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/kernel_ports.ts:930 infer ownership from matching branch/HEAD and absence of a foreign history entry. This does not prove batch-derived enrollment: runtime/kernel/enrollment.ts:177 initializes every enrollment, including independent enrollment, with history: []. An independently enrolled child on the batch branch at the same HEAD therefore passes isOwnClaim, and the new ownsTaskClaim override lets resumeBatch advance that foreign claim. The foreign-claim test only checks the different-branch case, masking this bypass. Require positive Kernel-owned evidence binding the active enrollment event to the batch; otherwise reject without writes. Add the same-branch, same-HEAD independent-enrollment case for both hosts.

[P1] plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/imm-unattended-batch.ts:165 rejects every dirty working tree even when resuming an existing batch; the corresponding Claude path at runtime/claude/kernel_ports.ts:971 does the same. A real child paused for foreground Review can have staged implementation or frozen artifact changes that remain uncommitted until the shared driver's post-settlement commit. The instructed second start_unattended_batch call consequently rejects before reaching resumeBatch. Manually committing to satisfy the recovery action moves HEAD outside the recorded batch lineage. Keep the clean-tree requirement for new batches, but validate existing-batch recovery against its authorized child scope and lineage.
